body.estimand_functional: \(Q_{a,H}=F_H(p_H)\quad\text{for }p_H\in\mathfrak D_H=\{q:q(c)>0\text{ for each branch-required cell and }d_{H,r}(q)>0\text{ for every registered reduced denominator}\}\), on the formula branch only

sampling_model.design: Independent sampling from the one coherent joint law \(p_H(V,S)\) with selector support exactly \(H\).
sampling_model.units: Observed units are i.i.d. draws of \((V,S)\); latent roots and response types are not observed.
sampling_model.treatment: The observed treatment components may be natural or selector-overridden according to the known gate encoded by \(S\); the target sets \(A=a\) and \(S=s_{\emptyset}\).
sampling_model.overlap: The proposal maintains the novel restricted-support condition \(p_H(c)>0\) only for structurally admissible cells \(c\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^{+})\), with no common numerical lower bound and no law supplied for \(s\notin H\). It guarantees the context normalizers, reachable fixing margins, and certified rational-elimination denominator factors recorded in \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}\). Statistical inference is pointwise at a fixed differentiable interior point of the returned branch domain.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The positive branch estimates the one finite supported-cell table empirically and evaluates its partial rational circuit only when the empirical table lies in the complete registered positive semialgebraic domain. An off-domain sample returns \(\bot_H\) and no point estimate or confidence set.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Algorithms 1--2 are sound, specified failure branches imply nonidentification, and completeness is conjectured.
Ordinary semi-Markovian ID is complete through identifying formulas or hedge countermodels.
Positive gID is sound and complete by reduction to classical ID subproblems.
Root-control CSI identification is equivalent to finitely many ordinary graphical identification problems.
Finite canonical SCMs represent all categorical counterfactual distributions and yield sharp polynomial-program bounds.
The arithmetic-circuit method is at least as complete as classical ID and do-calculus under strict positivity and can exploit additional model constraints.
Sufficient pruning and transit-clustering conditions preserve identification conclusions and transport do-calculus functionals.
Influence-function and weight-based estimators are derived for broad classes of identified effects in hidden-variable graphical models.

body.tldr: For a finite selector-gated semi-Markovian SCM observed on exactly \(H\), retained support normalization preserves the full observed--target relation. This round repairs the nonresidual SA-CS-ID architecture: a sole input-determined compiler runs explicit recursive tasks, derives each positivity-ledger margin, simulates every successful support-licensed Lee--Ghassami--Shpitser branch, and terminates by a finite multiset/count-vector descent even when district splitting spawns children. General residual exhaustion and the ordinary hedge-to-canonical-twin compiler remain open, so no formula-or-global-twin completeness claim is reported yet.

project_justification.gap: The published systematic-selection recursion is sound and has branchwise nonidentification results, but its completeness is conjectural and its failure construction is not typed as a support-exact, restricted-interior pair preserving every cell of the one supplied joint law. A further implementation-level gap is that a fixed recursion must schedule spawned district tasks without importing a successful derivation as input.
project_justification.niche: Fixed support is neither ordinary observational identification nor gID from separately supplied experiments: absent contexts cannot be invoked, while supported contexts remain coupled by one random selector and shared natural mechanisms.
project_justification.fill: The proved layer constructs the intrinsic normalized carrier, establishes inverse maps to the original fixed-support image, and gives an input-determined recursive task compiler with explicit selector, ancestor, district, prescribed-fixing, ledger, and multiset-progress invariants. It preserves every successful published positive branch. The intended field-level completion still requires the separate all-residual theorem producing either a verified rational projection or support-exact global twins in every irreducible state.

body.related_work: Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser (2024) provide the selector-gated model, Algorithms 1--2, soundness, branchwise nonidentification results, and an explicit completeness conjecture. The present proved positive layer normalizes a declared support while retaining the parameter image and simulates every successful support-licensed recursive branch with one input-determined task compiler; it does not yet settle their completeness conjecture. Kivva, Mokhtarian, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2022) motivate positivity-aware witness rebuilding for gID, but do not supply the required exact-support common contrast here. Shpitser and Pearl (2006) supply the classical ordinary formula-or-hedge classification; translating an arbitrary finite-categorical hedge into this verifier's rational-affine canonical twin box remains open. Tabell, Tikka, and Karvanen (2026) give sufficient pruning and formula transport for general data fusion, not inverse fixed-support parameter maps or all-residual twins. Tikka, Hyttinen, and Karvanen (2021) remain the software consumer reference.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The task compiler and successful-trace simulation remove the nonresidual scheduling circularity, but they do not prove that the finite residual projection and signed-row-swap libraries are exhaustive. A residual may have a fiber-constant target with only a nonrational algebraic representative, or every currently encoded response contrast may alter an observed descendant. The ordinary special case also lacks the required arbitrary-finite-alphabet hedge encoding and rational sign certificate. Boundary-uniform inference, off-domain regularization, and unrestricted quantifier elimination remain outside scope.
body.honest_scope: Established are the inverse fixed-support normalization, local certificate soundness, restricted-support denominator positivity, the new input-determined nonresidual task progress invariant, and preservation of successful published positive formulas. Still to prove are residual projection-or-global-contrast exhaustion, the resulting all-branch completeness theorem, and the exact ordinary hedge-to-canonical-twin residual compiler. The restricted admissible-cell interior imposes no uniform lower bound, and no absent selector context is supplied or inferred. The terminal three-observable classification and paired exact examples remain evidence for, not a proof of, the general residual theorem.
